lessons.exercise: On your own project, produce Defect report — so that: A defect report per deviation: build, criterion, reproduction steps, expected vs actual, evidence and severity.
lessons.prompt:
I'm working through "Log & Classify Defects" (Verify → Defect Triage & Resolution) on my own project. Act as my assistant: draft and check, I decide.

Goal: Make every deviation reproducible, traceable and rated, so it can be fixed and verified.
Done looks like: A defect report per deviation: build, criterion, reproduction steps, expected vs actual, evidence and severity.

I'll attach or paste: Test-run evidence; UAT execution log; Security test report; Accessibility audit report.

Work through these steps with me, one at a time:
1. Reproduce the deviation → Reproduction steps
2. Check for duplicates → Defect log
3. New and reproducible? (a decision — give me the options and a recommendation; I make the call)
4. Write report with evidence & severity → Defect report

Produce: Defect report. Use clear headings I can paste into my document.

Before you finish, check it against: Reproducible by someone else; Names build and criterion; Severity reflects impact; Reproducible; Linked to build and criterion.

Ask me for anything you need instead of guessing. Keep it specific to my project.

lessons.title: Run the Fix–Verify Loop
lessons.summary: Fix in BUILD, deliver a new build, re-test against it, regress, and close only when verified.

definition.purpose: Make 'fixed' mean verified on a named build, never just 'the developer says so'.

definition.jtbd: Help me trust that a closed defect is really gone and didn't break anything else.
